errors.text: The antiferromagnetic interaction is framed mainly as coupling across the fcc/C14 interface, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling between Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices and does not establish the interface as the exclusive location of that coupling.

The hypothesis says the C14 phase suppresses the fcc orbital moment, while the target holds that the intrinsically small fcc orbital contribution can still aid coercivity in the dual-phase, spin-canted and domain-wall-pinning environment.
It does not assign the 1084 K and 168 K transitions to the fcc phase and the approximately 214 K transition to C14, which is central to the phase-specific interpretation.
